items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1958-08-29
items.q: Mrs. Kimball was a piano player, her husband. With Celestan.

ctx.x: And oh I- Henry Kimball, the old man who played bass too. No, not him, I'm talking about- It was his son, was it?

Yeah. Mrs. Kimball was a piano player, her husband. With Celestan. Yeah. He used to play with Celestan too, but at that time he was playing with Sidney. And they had a wonderful band. And I'm telling you the truth Bill, those people really, they learned me something. Because when I got with that band, I could play the chords, but Sidney had a lot of stock arrangement, they didn't write chords out too much. And man they used to cut me every night. I was working 24 hours a day with the band because I had to take…
And that was right up my alley man.
